name: Gale Reef
description: Gale Reef is a relaxing getaway with clear water, reef views, and plenty of time to enjoy the beach. This trip is a good option for travelers who want a simple tropical vacation with snorkeling and resort activities.

name: Dawson's Reef
description: Dawson's Reef offers a balance of adventure and relaxation. Travelers can enjoy reef tours, beach access, and local dining while staying at a comfortable resort.

name: Claire's Reef
description: Claire's Reef is designed for travelers looking for a premium beach vacation. This package includes a luxury resort setting, scenic reef views, and access to guided activities.
